column1: Every company you have ever heard of... started the same way.
column2: 你聽過的每一間公司，都是這樣開始的。

column1: Someone stood up in front of a room, and asked them to believe.
column2: 有個人站到大家面前，請他們相信自己。

column1: You built something. Now you have three minutes, to make the whole room believe in it.
column2: 你做出了一個作品。現在，你有三分鐘，讓全場相信它。

column1: Everyone gets a sealed envelope of cash. How much is inside? Only you know.
column2: 每個人都會拿到一個封好的信封。裡面有多少錢？只有你知道。

column1: Listen to every pitch. Then put your money, where you believe.
column2: 聽完所有發表，把錢投給你相信的人。

column1: Just one rule. You can't invest in yourself.
column2: 只有一條規則：不能投給自己。

column1: The founder who raises the most, wins one month of Claude Team Premium.
column2: 募資最多的人，獨得 Claude Team Premium 一個月。

column1: October fifteenth. Bring your best pitch.
column2: 10 月 15 日，帶上你最好的 pitch。
